description: One entry of the anchored-text store: the file `<ab>/<cd>/<key>.json` under the store's directory, where the key is the SHA-256 of the bytes the text was extracted from, in hex. The Smelter writes it; the Archivist reads it. Written as compact JSON, `v` and `stamp` first, by writing a sibling temporary file and renaming it onto the path. The store's writer states its current stamp, followed by a newline, in the file `STAMP` at the store's root.

oneOf.description: The text extracted from the bytes, where each word is on the page, and how it was extracted.

stamp.description: The stamp of the writer that derived the entry. A reader takes the entry only when it equals the stamp the writer states in the store's `STAMP` file.

items.description: One line of text: the words that share a page, a baseline and a height.

y.description: The line's vertical position in PDF points, from the bottom of the page.

h.description: The line's height in PDF points.

words.description: Each word as `[x, width, start, end]`: its horizontal position and width in PDF points, and the offsets of its text in `text`.

lines.description: Where each word of `text` is, line by line, in reading order.

pdfClass.description: PDF classification, when the source was a PDF.

ocrConfidence.description: How well the engine read the pixels, when any of this text came from OCR.

lowConfidenceWords.description: Words the engine was unsure of.

unreadPages.description: 1-indexed pages this extraction could not read — present only for partially covered documents (class C).

oneOf.description: The bytes were declined: no text is extracted from them.

stamp.description: The stamp of the writer that derived the entry. A reader takes the entry only when it equals the stamp the writer states in the store's `STAMP` file.

declined.description: Why extraction yielded nothing, by class.
